transcript.content:
The issue is clear. In `modules/styles.py`, both `get_style_paths()` (line 169) and `save_styles()` (line 212) call `style_paths.remove("do_not_save")`. The divider styles with `path="do_not_save"` are only created when the styles filename contains a `*` wildcard (see `reload()`). When using the default `styles.csv` (no wildcard), no divider entries exist, so `"do_not_save"` is never added to the set, and `remove()` raises a `KeyError`.

The fix is to use `discard()` instead of `remove()` — `set.discard()` silently does nothing if the element is not present.
